Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein the desiccant is selected to enhance thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, enhancing the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, wherein said mass differential indicates maintained thermal stability.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, and said composition further contains a desiccant selected to enhance the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, and is formulated to contribute to the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, selected for its contribution to the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight-percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, wherein the desiccant is selected to enhance thermal stability. 

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, and is formulated to enhance the thermal stability of the composition.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, contributing to the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, and is included to enhance the thermal stability of the gas generant composition.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite, selected to enhance the thermal stability of the gas generant composition.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, indicating enhanced thermal stability of the composition.
